description: Updates a rendering placed on an item with new values.

dataSource.description: New rendering data source if specified.

database.description: The context database. Only sent when addressing by id -- a path carries its own database prefix (e.g. master:/sitecore/content/Home).

finalLayout.description: Target the final layout (default true), where list-renderings' uniqueIds live. False = shared only.

id.description: The ID of the item holding the rendering. Supply this or path.

index.description: New index of the rendering in the layout.

language.description: The language version of the item holding the rendering.

path.description: The path of the item holding the rendering. Supply this or id.

placeholder.description: New rendering placeholder value if specified.

uniqueId.description: The unique ID of the rendering.

name: presentation-set-rendering
